title: Design System: James Gardener — Big Box

display.purpose: The box-front name only; six-step printed extrusion.

headline.purpose: Project and section titles; container-query sized to their column; four-step extrusion.

title.purpose: Credit roles, contents entries, small Bowlby heads.

label.purpose: Archivo at 87.5% width, bold uppercase: buttons, labels, legal text.

editions.selector: [data-theme="light"] on <html>, set before first paint in index.html from ?edition= or localStorage.theme; default dark.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Screenshot frame and status sticker: objects sitting on the print.

shadows.name: sticker-drop
shadows.purpose: PLAY NOW burst (filter, follows the starburst outline).

shadows.name: turn-rest
shadows.purpose: Turn it over button at rest; 0 10px 18px -6px on hover, 0 3px 8px -4px on press.

shadows.name: spine-fold
shadows.purpose: The fold where spine meets box (inset 0 -3px 0 on phones).

shadows.name: extrusion-panel
shadows.purpose: Printed title extrusion on panel and Credits titles (3 steps on the publisher title).

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: The arrow nudge loop and the idle hinge-peek.

motion.name: box-turn
motion.value: GSAP ScrollTrigger pin, scrub 0.5, end +=90%; front rotateY 0 to 100deg (power2.in), shade 0 to 0.75, back scale 0.95 to 1

motion.name: hinge-peek
motion.value: box-peek 1.5s ease-in-out x2 after 2.2s idle at top (rotate y 0, 11deg, 3deg, 0)

motion.name: turn-nudge
motion.purpose: Turn button arrow: this box scrolls.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: no pin (front and back stack), thumbnails render one still, all transitions and animations collapse to 0.01ms, smooth scroll off

breakpoints.name: phone-narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Credit leaders drop; publisher strip stacks.

breakpoints.name: modal-sm
breakpoints.purpose: Game modal panel 85vw x 80vh (75vw x 78vh from 1024px).

breakpoints.name: stack
breakpoints.purpose: Back cover and project panels go single column.

narrative.northStar: The Big Box on the Shelf
narrative.overview:
The site is a printed 1990s PC game box, not a web page dressed as one. Saturated print inks own whole regions edge to edge; nothing floats on a neutral canvas. You hold it by a red spine, you see a box front with live cover art and a sale sticker, you turn it over, and every project is a back-of-box panel: a framed screenshot, plain diamond-bulleted features, and a System Requirements box that is the project's stack. A yellow publisher strip with a barcode closes the box.

The system ships in two editions that share one set of fixed inks. The **black box** (dark theme, the default) keeps its fields dark: black, blue, oxblood, red. The **white box** (light theme) prints on paper, yellow, blue and red. The theme never changes an ink; it changes which ink each slot prints with. Density is loud and confident at the display level and plain, readable small print underneath: heavy box lettering with a printed extrusion over honest, factual copy.

The world explicitly replaced a near-black, single-glowing-accent dev portfolio (Syne and Inter, card grid, hero blurb). Everything that made that look (glow, glass, gradient, eyebrow labels, section numbers, loaders, marquees, count-ups, custom cursors) is off the table.
keyCharacteristics: Fixed print inks; editions re-ink slots, never the inks themselves.
Bowlby One box lettering with a stepped, hard offset extrusion; Archivo condensed to 87.5% as the small-print voice.
Square printed edges and thick 3px black rules; the only rounded corner is the die-cut screenshot.
One authored motion moment (the box turn) plus live PixiJS thumbnails; no section entrances.
WCAG AA in both editions, checked per tone slot.

rules.name: The Fixed Ink Rule
rules.body: The eight print inks never change with the theme. An edition only reassigns which ink a slot prints with, through `--paper`, `--ink`, `--title-fill`, `--title-extrude`, `--sysreq-*` and the panel tone tokens.

rules.name: The Tone Slot Rule
rules.body: Project panels cycle four slots in page order. Black box: black, blue, oxblood, red. White box: paper, yellow, blue, red. Everything inside a panel (background, ink, secondary ink, title fill, mark, frame, extrusion, primary button, status sticker, System Requirements header) is driven by that slot's `--tone-*`, `--btn-*`, `--status-*` and `--tone-extrude` tokens, never by a hard-coded colour. A new slot or a changed slot is re-checked for WCAG AA.

rules.name: The Large-Yellow Rule
rules.body: Yellow on red or on blue (about 3.8:1 and 4.3:1) is for large display text only: titles, the spine mark, the sticker. Body text, labels and buttons on red or blue print in white or black.

rules.name: The Printed Extrusion Rule
rules.body: Box titles carry a stepped hard offset in the edition's extrusion ink: 6 steps of 1px on the cover, 4 on panel and Credits titles, 3 on the publisher title. The extrusion is native to this world; it is the box-art title treatment, not a decorative shadow, and it belongs to Bowlby One display text only.

rules.name: The Small Print Rule
rules.body: The 87.5% width is the small-print voice. Use it for labels, buttons and legal text, never for running paragraphs.

rules.name: The Sits-On-The-Print Rule
rules.body: A soft drop shadow is allowed only on an object stuck onto the box (sticker, screenshot, the turn button). Fields, panels and plates are flat.

dos: **Do** print whole regions in one ink and separate them with a 3px black rule.
**Do** drive every colour inside a project panel from its tone slot tokens, and re-check WCAG AA in both editions when touching a slot.
**Do** keep yellow on red or blue to large display text; body, labels and buttons there print in white or black.
**Do** give Bowlby One titles the printed extrusion in the edition's extrusion ink.
**Do** keep motion to the box turn and the live thumbnails, and give every effect a reduced-motion path (no pin, still thumbnails, collapsed transitions).
**Do** keep thumbnails as live code-drawn PixiJS "screenshots" in the die-cut frame.
donts: **Don't** use glows, glassmorphism or gradients (including gradient text).
**Don't** add eyebrow labels above headings or section numbers.
**Don't** add loaders, marquees, count-up stats or custom cursors.
**Don't** round anything but the die-cut screenshot and the two circular controls.
**Don't** change a print ink per edition; re-ink a slot instead.
